svg.title: One task, from request to review.
svg.desc: 1. Describe your request to Spec, then review the goal and completion criteria. 2. Start Seal separately by specifying the goal folder in a new message. The agent builds, checks, fixes, and records progress. 3. Read the changes and check records, and review the result against the goal. To resume in a new conversation, open the same project and name the same goal. This is a concept illustration, not an actual execution result.
